items.Sentence: The wastewater treatment process consisted of primary sedimentation through two parallel· concrete septic tanks.

SSD discharged treated municipal wastewater to evaporation/percolation ponds under Waste Discharge Requirements (WDRs) Order No. 94-032 adopted on April' 4, 1994, and amended by WDR Order No. 97-1 05 adopted on July 21, 1997.

In addition, TSO No. 01-156 ordered SSD to undertake a technical investigation to determine other corrective actions, including disinfection unit construction if the upgraded Jose Flores WWTP was not sufficient to bring the effluent into full compliance.
